name: ai-command
description: Natural language to shell command via a locally installed AI CLI (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, or a custom command): "AI: Generate Command" in the palette (or a "??" quick-switcher query) types the generated command at the prompt for review — never runs it.

aiCommand.provider.description: Which locally installed AI CLI generates commands.

aiCommand.binaryPath.description: Override the selected provider's binary (name on PATH, or an absolute path). Empty uses the provider's default (claude / codex / gemini). Ignored for the custom provider.

aiCommand.model.description: Model passed to the provider CLI (--model for claude, -m for codex/gemini). Empty uses the CLI's default; a small model responds fastest. Ignored for the custom provider.

aiCommand.customCommand.description: Custom provider only: a shell command line that receives the prompt as its single trailing argument and prints exactly one shell command, e.g. `my-llm --quiet`.
